_comment: Capture signals for capture_scanner (UserPromptSubmit rail). Conservative multi-word phrases keep false positives low; tune here WITHOUT recompiling (Go reads this at runtime). Matching is case-insensitive with Unicode word-boundary checks, so a phrase only fires when flanked by non-letters. Add a phrase to widen a category; remove one to quiet it. English and Russian phrases ship together because the matcher does not care which language the prompt is in - add your own the same way. The hint is what the agent reads, and it is a suggestion: nothing becomes a note without the user.

categories.hint: This looks like a DECISION. If it is durable, meaning it shapes future work, record it together with the reason behind it so the same choice is not reopened in a month.
This looks like a GOTCHA: a trap that is not obvious from the outside. Record the symptom that gives it away, not only the fix, so the next encounter is recognised instead of re-debugged.
This looks like a recurring PATTERN or rule. Recurring knowledge belongs in one note rather than resurfacing in conversation after conversation: stage it in raw/ and run /compile.
patterns: каждый раз одно и то же

categories.hint: This looks like a REJECTED approach. Record it with the reason it failed, so the same dead end is not explored again in six months.
